cost_deferral.finding: No capitalized software or development cost is tagged in any period; research and development is expensed, {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.value} over the trailing four quarters, with the six-month figure {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.this_year_to_date.value} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.prior_year_to_date.value} a year earlier, attributed to personnel and new-product-introduction costs. The deferral that is growing is deferred cost of goods sold inside prepaid and other current assets: the tagged current deferred-cost balance rose against year end and is several times its level at the end of 2024, and the note attributes it to a corresponding increase in deferred product revenue — matched deferral, benign while acceptance is obtained, but it becomes an inventory write-down if trials fail, as the MD&A itself says. Soft assets are at a record share: {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value} of total assets, the highest of six quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.soft_asset_share.value} a year earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.soft_asset_share.value} two years earlier, and {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value} for 2025, the highest of five years; the driver is marketable securities ({terms.balances_now.short_term_investments.value}) plus deferred costs, receivables and inventory rather than intangibles. Non-recurring items: neither report names a non-recurring charge, so nothing recurs. The non-GAAP to GAAP gap cannot be trended from the record; the release prints a quarterly gap made of share-based compensation, intangible amortization and tax effects, and — the substantive point — the company changed its non-GAAP tax method from the fourth quarter of 2025 and recast prior periods, which raised the year-earlier non-GAAP net income; the headline non-GAAP EPS growth is measured against that recast base, while GAAP net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year.value|pct}. Share-based compensation over the trailing four quarters is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value}, rising, with grant-date fair values of new units about double the prior nonvested pool, so the GAAP-to-non-GAAP gap will widen as those units vest.
cost_deferral.verdict: no development-cost capitalization; deferred cost of goods sold and soft-asset share at record levels but matched to deferred revenue and securities; the non-GAAP comparison base was recast upward

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The earnings-release 8-K and the 10-Q carry the same quarterly revenue, the same quarterly net income and the same current deferred revenue, and both show the year-over-year gross-margin decline; the release matches the filing. Of the forty notes items carrying an expected direction, the numbers confirm twenty-three, contradict none outright, and leave seventeen unresolved — the unresolved ones being forward-looking outlook levels, conditional risk statements, disclosure-wording changes with no amount, insider trading plans, and two cross-document tensions: the chief financial officer's quoted EPS growth figure names no basis while GAAP net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year.value|pct}, and the release's broad-based growth language sits beside the 10-Q's attribution of the gross-margin decline to large end customers with higher discounts. The one prose-versus-prose inconsistency inside the 10-Q is the receivables cause: the liquidity paragraph names extended payment terms for large customers, the operating-cash-flow paragraph names only higher billings. The next-quarter non-GAAP operating-margin range the release gives sits below the margin just reported, which the numbers reader records as a downward direction.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: release and filing agree on every headline figure; most directional claims are confirmed by the numbers; the open items are forward statements and two basis-of-comparison questions

summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망 금융은 발견되지 않았습니다. 부외 구매약정은 최근 네 분기 매출원가 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue.value}보다 크고 계속 늘고 있으며, 약정 범위 설명 문장이 삭제되었습니다. 주식보상비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value}를 차감한 조정 잉여현금흐름은 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.value}입니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 감사인 변경, 중요한 취약점, 지연 제출, 재작성은 없습니다. 10-K와 10-Q의 설비투자 태그가 다르고, CFO와 이사가 분기 중 주식 매도 계획을 수정·신설했습니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 8-K 실적 발표와 10-Q의 분기 매출, 순이익, 이연수익은 일치합니다. 공시 문장 대부분은 숫자로 확인되었고, CFO 인용문의 EPS 성장률 기준 미표시와 '광범위한 성장' 대 대형고객 할인 설명의 차이는 미해결로 남았습니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고는 {terms.balances_now.inventory.value}로 늘었지만 재고일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}일로 줄었고, 원재료와 평가용 재고가 급증했습니다. 2025년 한 리셀러가 매출의 {concentration.facts.6.value|pct}, 다른 리셀러가 매출채권의 {concentration.facts.7.value|pct}를 차지해 집중도가 높으며, 순환 거래나 고객 투자 징후는 없습니다.
